answer: Gate every network inlet with hardware-bound identity: accept a request only if it carries an attestation signed by a secure enclave whose key cannot be exported or cloned. The Lotus attestation service issues one certificate per physical device, each costing hardware the owner must possess, so a sybil operator needs N devices for N personas - no batch discount - while an honest agent buys one. Misused devices are burned into the Mesa revocation ledger, which no inlet accepts. Farming personas costs full hardware per clone; one honest agent costs exactly one device.
